item: RE4 evidence plan G.3 -- predictor diagnostics for the joint-space robots

fit_plant_provenance.aloha: imported openpi/aloha_adapt.py: fit_plant (module level is stdlib + numpy only)
fit_plant_provenance.gr1: openpi/gr1_adapt.py imports gymnasium/robocasa at module level, so fit_plant was extracted verbatim with ast and executed with the module's NJ=29, K_FIR=6; its body is token-identical to aloha_adapt.fit_plant apart from the docstring

definitions.rows: t >= K_FIR (=6) of every episode, the exact rows fit_plant uses
definitions.fir: q_hat[t] = sum_{k=0..6} h_k u[t-k] + c   (u = command applied at step t, q[t] measured after it)
definitions.increment: dy[t] = q[t] - q[t-1]; FIR increment = q_hat_FIR[t] - q[t-1]; persistence increment = 0
definitions.const_velocity: extra command-free baseline: dy_hat[t] = q[t-1] - q[t-2]
definitions.r2: 1 - SSE / sum (y - mean y)^2 on the quantity named
definitions.skill_vs_persistence: 1 - SSE_FIR / SSE_persistence on absolute position; because the FIR position error equals its increment error, this is also the uncentred incremental R^2

in_sample.note: shipped W = fit_plant(full log); evaluated on the same rows it was fitted on
